defects.claim: The issue asked to restyle `DashboardShippedChart` or replace its use on the dashboard. The PR did neither: it added a second chart, so the page now shows two activity charts
defects.evidence: `src/views/DashboardView.vue:339` still renders `<DashboardShippedChart :activity="filteredActivity" :projects="projects" />` inside the old "Shipped Activity" section (:332-340), and the new `<DashboardActivityChart :events="boardActivity" />` sits right below it at :342.

defects.claim: The issue requires that if the endpoint has no range parameter, the PR body must say the bucketing is client-side. The endpoint has no range parameter (`src/lib/api/httpAdapter.ts:1584` `request<WireActivityEnvelope>('/api/v1/board/activity')`), but the PR body only repeats the issue text and the Evidence block. The client-side note appears only in the component docblock (`DashboardActivityChart.vue:10`).
The docblock says the older `DashboardShippedChart` is "still used by Settings → Usage", which hides that `DashboardView.vue:339` uses it too.

The highlight colour `bg-needs-you` is magenta (`src/design-system/theme.css:27` `--color-needs-you: #b04a92;`), not a warm accent. The deviation is documented, and `dashboardShippedColors.ts:7` really has only neutral `--color-chart-*` greys.
The docblock says "no mock — vocabulary extension (Figma 2026-10…)", but the dashboard has a design file (`design/dashboard-v4.html`). CLAUDE.md rule 2 asks for the design file citation.

`now` defaults to `new Date()` once at mount, and buckets are counted back from that moment, not from calendar day or hour boundaries. On a long-open dashboard the window goes stale and never includes events that arrive later.
No test covers the new `loadBoardActivity` wiring or the chart mounting in `DashboardView` (Grep for `listBoardActivity|DashboardActivityChart` in that spec found nothing).

not_verified: Whether the console's `/api/v1/board/activity` returns the full 30-day history or a capped page; the server is not in this checkout, so the 30D bars may undercount.
Whether 30 bars (about 522px wide) fit at the `md` breakpoint without `overflow-hidden` (:75) cutting off the newest buckets; this needs a real browser, which a read-only checkout can't run.
